ECP3524.title: The Economics of Religion
ECP3524.prerequisites: ECO 2023 Principles of Microeconomics (statewide record). Intermediate micro (ECO 3101) is not required, so the course is open after principles, including to non-majors; confirm FSU's current requisite before registering. Taught only at Florida State University, and new: the course record took effect 24 August 2026, so no published syllabus was found and emphasis is set by the instructor. No general-education or Gordon Rule designation. An economics course, not a religious-studies one: it explains religious behaviour with economic models and does not judge belief.

offering_notes.summary: One public carrier, Florida State University, at 3 credits. FSU lists 3 contact hours a week (45 a semester). New in fall 2026.
offering_notes.derivation: FSU's course record lists 3 contact hours a week of class lecture; 15 weeks gives 45, which matches Florida's 15-hours-per-credit convention for a 3-credit lecture course.
